span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Cheaper head-mounted displays with audio-visual immersivity plus a growing library of educational applications remove the cost and usability barriers, which is what now permits adoption in universities rather than only in the military and medicine.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Prior everyday exposure to consumer motion-sensing and touchscreen devices lowers the perceived novelty of VR, which reduces visitors' reluctance to try immersive installations.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: What the study measures is what students and faculty say on a rating scale, not any learning outcome.
span.note: what this limits: the educational claims made from this study: the outcome recorded is perceived usefulness reported by students and faculty on a Likert scale, so it is a measure of opinion about the technology rather than of learning
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Half the surveyed students did not want the technology used in their other courses.
span.note: what this limits: the enthusiasm reported here as support for wider adoption: only half of the polled group said they would like to see such experiences integrated into other coursework
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: What the existing literature covers is attributed to what was affordable, not to what was found.
span.note: what this limits: the state of the VR-in-education literature: its limitations and range are attributed to the budgetary and technological constraints faced by previous educators, so absence of evidence in an area reflects cost rather than a negative finding
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The field is stated to have limited understanding of how the technology affects any specific learning outcome.
span.note: what this limits: a claim that VR enhances learning: the paper states there is limited understanding of exactly how VR can be used to enhance specific learning outcomes
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: control groups shown only text, pictures and PowerPoint slides, but taken through the SAME SEQUENCE OF EVENTS as the virtual-reality group
span.note: eliminates: the novelty and structure of the session rather than the virtual reality - same sequence, same duration, different medium
